## Hotfix v2.0.2 - Code Quality Improvements

**Released:** 2026-10-27

### Changed
- Removed debug logging statements from CoopMenuUI.cs
- Fixed MockNetworkTransport duplicate connection events
- Improved packet ordering comments

### Installation
1. Download SilksongCoop_v2.0.2.zip
2. Extract to game folder (overwrite)
3. Launch game
4. F10 - co-op menu, F11 - diagnostics
name: v2.0.2 - Code Quality Improvements
